;
;----------------------------
        .IF     PASS
PASS    equ     1
REPTCNT equ     1
        .ENDIF
;
        defmac  GENSINUS
;
        org     SIN_ADR
        defb    SIN_X/256
        org     $+127
        defb    0-(SIN_X/256)
;
        org     SIN_ADR-1+(REPTCNT*2)
        defb    SIN_X/256
        org     $+127
        defb    0-(SIN_X/256)
;
SIN_ADR =       SIN_ADR+1
;
SIN_X   =       SIN_X+(SIN_Y/41)
SIN_Y   =       SIN_Y-(SIN_X/41)
;
REPTCNT =       REPTCNT-1
        .IF     REPTCNT
        .ELSE
        GENSINUS
        .ENDIF
        endmac
;
;=====================
        org     #8000
;
SIN_X           equ     0
SIN_Y           equ     #7F00
SIN_ADR         equ     $
        GENSINUS
REPTCNT         =       64
        org     SIN_ADR+256
;
